# Original demonstration lexicon

These eighteen vocabulary records and artificial weights were written for
Waypinyin build and smoke tests. They are licensed under the project MIT license.
No records or frequencies were extracted from the historical third-party data.
The filenames satisfy the compiler input contract; empty source lists contain
only comments. This fixture is not a daily-use Chinese dictionary or GB2312
coverage claim. Public source builds use it unless external data is supplied.
